mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 trend reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.1% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 0.1%, or the rate hike is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL (inflation) signal conflicting monetary policy signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns positive despite both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), sustained low unemployment (UNRATE) and rising GDP (GDPC1) reinforce market optimism, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods despite the signal, or UNRATE exceeds 3.5% during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained PAYEMS growth, or employment peaks and declines before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP (GDPC1) crossing above 20,000 Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars signals robust demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 20,000, or the threshold is not met within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) simultaneously signal economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising, or the interaction effect is insignificant.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and industrial production (HOUST) declining), conflicting signals reduce market optimism, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during a tightening cycle, or the regime conditions are not met.
